command.previewSelection.title: CSV/TSV: Preview Selection as Table
command.openFile.title: CSV/TSV: View as Table
config.selectionDelimiter.description: Delimiter used when previewing selected text. "auto" guesses from the selection.
config.hasHeader.description: Treat the first row as a header row.
config.pageSize.description: Number of rows to display per page.
config.encoding.description: Text encoding used when opening files. "auto" honours a BOM, then tries UTF-8 and falls back to Shift_JIS.
config.followSelection.description: Update the preview automatically when the editor selection changes.
config.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to display. Larger files are truncated.
config.language.description: UI language. "auto" follows the VS Code display language. Set to "en" or "ja" to override.
